The '''Diplomatic Escort Group''',<ref name="Ultimate Battles" /> also known as '''Senate Security''',<ref name="Hasbro" /> or simply as the '''diplomatic service''',<ref name="Ambush Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep101|text="Ambush" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] branch of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] specialized in escorting diplomats to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] all around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ultimate Battles" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|deliver]] a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] ransom to a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|band]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] based on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] that had captured [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. A [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] entered the system carrying the spice and escort group, but the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was ambushed by a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class Weequay ship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by rogue pirate [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]]. The enemy [[Starship/Legends|ship]] shot down the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] shuttle and caused it to crash in the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]] on Florrum's surface. Both the shuttle's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and Senator Kharrus were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the crash, leaving [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] as the highest ranking individual.<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

[[File:Shot_down.png|thumb|left|200px|The Escort Group's shuttle is shot down over Florrum.]]
After Kharrus had been buried and given an impromptu funeral, the pirate [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] and a squad of [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]]&ndash;mounted pirates ambushed the clones and stole the spice, but Binks and the clones eventually used [[Skalder/Legends|skalder]] mounts to retrieve the ransom. The pirates then used [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tanks]] in an attempt to wipe out the clones, but the Republic forces managed to defeat the pirates and commandeer the craft, taking them to the pirate outpost. The Escort Group arrived at the facility and departed Florrum with Skywalker and Kenobi, who had escaped a brief captivity at the hands of the pirates.<ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>
